notes: Price-based figures are derived from third-party prices (one-off internal snapshot): current S&P 500 members, so earlier years carry survivorship bias. Past year: cap-weighted 17.3%, equal-weighted 20.9%, median stock 10.4%.
Frontier P/E is the median of 19 frontier country-index trailing P/Es at 30 Sep 2026 (emerging-market median 12.7); 12-month returns are in USD, derived from third-party prices.
Public float is the cover-page value each filer reports (measured at the end of its second fiscal quarter, Oct-Sep window); a proxy for size, not market capitalisation.
Margins and breadth use calendar-year XBRL frames; financials (SIC 6000-6799) are excluded from margins.
Real rate = policy rate (or T-bill/discount rate where flagged) minus latest CPI inflation.
Event dates are the first day of each prediction's scoring window.
Predictions are paper only: no trades, no accounts. Locks are SHA-256 hashes; the first 12 characters are shown.
